title: The Mughals Conspiracy Against Banda Singh And their Eulogy of (Tat Khalsa) Singhs

blocks.text: The Mughals next court Banda’s own men directly, offering money and rank in exchange for information, submission, and eventual separation from their leader.
Rank, cash, and closeness to power are the tools used to weaken loyalty from inside the camp.
The phrase money and rank captures the method of corruption and recruitment at work on this page.
